bootstrap.resampling_unit: shared source seed; retain all models, scenarios, samples, origins, and destinations

analysis_contract.interval_interpretation: descriptive pointwise 95% shared-seed cluster intervals; no family-wise error control
analysis_contract.overall_weighting: equal weight per complete model-scenario-seed-sample base pair; provider mix follows the frozen design (GLM 60%, DeepSeek 40%)

ranking.agreement: Kendall tau-b between E0 and E1 destination rankings

claim_boundary.between_origin_contrast: realized response-path contrast; includes sampling, feedback, and provider-time drift
claim_boundary.causal_execution_contrast: within one frozen response tape, pre-risk decisions are verified fixed; downstream risk approval remains execution-endogenous
claim_boundary.forbidden_claim: the original E0/E1 diagonal difference isolates execution
claim_boundary.ranking_claim_rule: claim execution-alone ranking sensitivity only when both response-origin strata agree and the seed-cluster interval is stable

diagonal_reproduction.float_rule: round(new_value, 6) equals the published submission value

estimands: destination execution contrast within response origin I0
destination execution contrast within response origin I1
execution and realized-path Shapley decomposition of the observed diagonal difference
historical_metadata_note: The frozen plan rows and call packets contain 900 rows / 30 model-scenario groups. The older plan summary's 450 / 15 values are stale and are not used.
source_hash_policy: sha256 of text bytes after CRLF/CR -> LF normalization
stop_rule: publish nothing unless the frozen implementation and exact source file sets match, all 900 source rows and 450 E0/E1 pairs validate, all 1800 replays consume their response tapes, pre-risk decisions stay fixed across destinations, and 900 diagonal metric checks pass
